# UPchieve Changelog, week of Aug 29 to Sep 5, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Sep 4, subway Sep 4. These deploys carried the PhotoDNA screening, secret-scanning, and NTHS eligibility work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Refuse an application from a coach who already has one.** Eligibility also checks whether the coach is an active member of a chapter and whether they have ever applied before; either one makes them ineligible. Every NTHS surface routes through one destination function so the guards share the access logic, and changing occupation refreshes the store, since occupation decides eligibility. ([subway !2878](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2878); [high-line !1859](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1859)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Put the chapter-type choice into the onboarding checklist.** School-approved versus community now sits after orientation and links to a redesigned "Choose Your Chapter Type" card. Its checklist row cannot be ticked by hand and checks itself off the president's setting instead; cancelling the advisor form no longer counts as opting out, and leaves the president able to change their mind with the CTA still asking for the form; checklist rows take an optional trailing control, a button for somewhere inside the app or an out-arrow for anything leaving it; and the disabled row explains itself through a tooltip anchored to a focusable `aria-disabled` checkbox. ([high-line !1871](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1871)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Give the candidate status email the processor it runs on.** The job that emails a candidate when their application is approved or denied shipped last week without it. ([subway !2892](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2892)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Nudge a candidate who applied but has not founded their chapter.** Four SendGrid templates go out 3, 5, 8, and 12 days after their application was activated, and the query skips anyone who has already had that email or a later one in the same cohort, so a candidate who goes quiet for two weeks gets four nudges rather than one repeated. ([subway !2895](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2895)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Hand the frontend the school a dual-role coach already has on file.** `studentSchoolId` comes off `student_profiles.school_id` on the user object, so a coach who is also a student is not asked for a school the app already knows. ([subway !2851](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2851)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Removed the NTHS approval endpoints.** Retool decides applications with its own SQL, so the endpoints had no caller, and nobody wanted to maintain an API surface that is not needed yet. Last week's digest read this branch as adding bulk approval; it landed as a removal. ([subway !2888](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2888)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🧪 **Open the chapter application to eligible high school coaches.** The page had been switched off since July. It reaches coaches who are high school students, approved and onboarded, past their first session, unbanned, not already in a chapter, and not attached to a school partner ([`nths-application-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/593343)), and the splash copy was rewritten for them ([high-line !1872](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1872)). *Kasozi Wilson, Ben Wheeler*
- 🧪 **Record what an admin decided on an application, and return the reasons a coach was blocked.** The eligibility reasons the service already computes come back on the response, and approving or denying in Retool fires its own event, which closes the funnel the in-app instrumentation opened last week. ([subway !2884](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2884)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Let a coach whose school affiliation was denied choose their path again.** ([high-line !1876](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1876)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Student → Volunteer (S2V)

Lets a student become a volunteer coach on the same account, switching modes instead of creating a second one, so they can earn verified volunteer service hours.

- 🧪 **Guard `/volunteer-hours` on the flag that hides its sidebar link.** An 8th grader reached the signup page: the link was gated but the route was not, so anyone holding the URL, from an email for instance, still landed on it. The route sends them to the dashboard now unless the flag says otherwise, and the unused `showCalculator` payload getter came out with it. The page reaches students above 8th grade who are not banned, all of them on the `control` variant ([`show-student-to-volunteer-hours-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/706824)). 🐛 [#718](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/718) ([high-line !1882](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1882)) *Alex Lindsay*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Screen image uploads with PhotoDNA before they are stored.** [#658](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/658): the middleware, which checks a request body for an image file, sends it to PhotoDNA, and on a match quarantines it in a separate Azure container with the session id, upload kind, and user id recorded so the security team can report to NCMEC ([subway !2840](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2840)); whiteboard and document-editor uploads moved to the backend, keeping their existing hosts ([subway !2757](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2757), [high-line !1709](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1709)); volunteer photo IDs uploaded through the backend too, checked against PhotoDNA but not moderated ([subway !2758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2758), [high-line !1711](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1711)); a `quarantined_on` column on moderation infractions ([subway !2807](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2807)); the infraction's session id made nullable, since a quarantined volunteer photo ID does not come from a session ([subway !2832](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2832)); the moderation-infraction reads moved from `makeRequired` to `makeSomeRequired` ([subway !2831](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2831)); assignment attachments converted to jpeg or png before they are submitted, since moderation and PhotoDNA only take those ([high-line !1870](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1870)); `moderation_infractions` opened to the basic-access role so a Zapier safety alert can read `quarantined_on` ([subway !2906](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2906)). Screening reaches everyone as of Sep 4 ([`photodna-match-check`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/853470)). Screenshares stay unscreened until rate limiting is worked out. *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Show a student every coach they have worked with, not only the ones they starred.** The favorite-tutors view is gone, replaced by a past-coaches view with a favorites toggle, and students can still star a coach from it. Clicking through to a coach's session stats, DMing them from one place instead of Session History, and starting a session with them are the next steps. ([subway !2900](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2900); [high-line !1875](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1875)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Tune image moderation:** a rewritten `MODERATE_IMAGE` fallback prompt, matching the one already in Langfuse ([subway !2911](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2911)); a low-confidence category to go with it, at a 50% threshold rather than the higher bar the other categories use ([subway !2912](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2912)); a category the model was not expected to return logged as an error and run against the default threshold, instead of being dropped as a possible infraction ([subway !2910](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2910)). *Alex Lindsay*
- **Track doc-editor and whiteboard activity for a truer `time_tutored`:** 🚀 the `session_editor_activity` table ([subway !2904](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2904)) and its line in the schema dump ([subway !2902](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2902)); ✅ the code that writes to it, hooking Quill updates and `transmitWhiteboardActivity` events, throttled on both sides by a five-minute Redis key, and feeding `computeAbsentStudent`, `computeAbsentVolunteer`, and `calculateTimeTutored` ([subway !2905](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2905), [high-line !1881](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1881)). Sessions spent mostly or entirely in the doc editor have been coming out at zero or undercounted. *sammy nave*
- 🧪 **Take async essay review to a second subject, College List.** The first run was inconclusive because too few students went through it, and staff reviewing every essay by hand capped how far it could be opened up; coaches took the reviewing over last week, so the funnel can widen now. The College List submission is gated on the coach's subjects and certifications ([subway !2898](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2898), [high-line !1873](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1873)); a pending-submission count sits on the coach's dashboard card, counting only submissions they are certified for, still open, and not already reviewed by them ([subway !2901](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2901), [high-line !1877](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1877)); a student loading a submission page fires its own event, since PostHog was missing steps between reaching College List and submitting ([high-line !1884](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1884)). Both sides moved to half their cohort on Sep 1, students ([`async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/806269)) and coaches ([`volunteer-async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/844969)), and the coach notification email switched on for the first time, at 10% of coaches ([`volunteer-async-essay-review-email-notifications`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/844972)). *Trey Stevens*
- 🧪 **Record a coach declining to share their info.** The opt-in modal fired an event when a coach agreed and nothing when they refused, so the 20% of coaches in the experiment only registered one way ([`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424)). ([high-line !1874](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1874)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Retire the deprecated image-upload-URL route:** 🎁 the frontend call ([high-line !1885](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1885)); 👀 the route itself ([subway !2914](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2914)). The old flow moderated an image, handed the client an upload URL, and let the client do the upload, so once it held the URL it could upload any picture it liked. The backend uploads straight after moderation now and nothing needs the URL. *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Realtime presence plumbing.** ([subway !2903](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2903)) *sammy nave*
- 👀 **Keep a just-matched session request clickable for about 30 seconds.** A coach who is slightly too slow has the request disappear before they can click it, and the click is the only unambiguous signal that they meant to take it, so `session_failed_joins` never records the intent. The dashboard row and its toast linger instead, and a repeat broadcast can no longer stack a fresh uncancelable timer on a lingering session. The flag it sits behind has not been created in PostHog, so nobody has it. ([high-line !1880](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1880)) *Macy Lam*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Stop the axios response interceptor from destroying network errors.** The interceptor in `router.ts` read `error.response.data` with no guard, and axios only sets `response` when one actually arrived, so on an offline, timeout, dropped, or cancelled request the interceptor threw while inspecting the error and its own TypeError replaced the real one. It had been doing that for over two years. The error returns untouched now when there is no response. Network-failure volume in New Relic will look like it jumps; it was already happening. ([high-line !1858](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1858)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Drop the grade-level join from `getSessionUsers`.** The query scanned all 136,821 rows of `users_grade_levels` and joined them to `grade_levels` before narrowing to the two people in the session, for a grade level nothing read. Removing the two joins takes it from 173.8 ms to 0.3 ms. ([subway !2907](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2907)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Load session history when the page is opened cold.** Sessions rendered when you navigated to the view but not when you landed on it or refreshed it, because a query-string value was compared as a string where a boolean was expected. Tests cover the conversion now. 🐛 [#703](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/703) ([high-line !1883](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1883)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Stop adding a line break when a message is sent in session chat.** The TipTap editor added for maths and LaTeX registered its `@keydown` listener too late to cancel the newline: a clean message flickered a row taller before resetting, and a moderated one, whose text is never reset, grew another row on every press of enter. Also cleans TipTap up on unmount, and emits the typing indicator while someone is using the maths keyboard. 🐛 [#702](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/702) ([high-line !1879](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1879)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Bring the moderation thresholds onto the same scale as the scores they are checked against.** Both branches multiplied a database-configured threshold by 100 and compared it to a 0 to 1 score, so `RUDE_GESTURES` never matched and the address-detection threshold was unreachable. ([subway !2845](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2845), [subway !2846](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2846)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Store the session photo key for whiteboard images again.** It is meant to be stored for the whiteboard as well as the document editor, and a later change in `SessionService` stopped doing it for whiteboard images. ([subway !2915](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2915)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Escape the non-LaTeX parts of a chat message every time.** `renderLatex` took its escaping function as an optional argument, so any caller that left it out had its text interpolated raw through `v-html`. It escapes with `lodash-es` now, and the hand-rolled `createTextNode` helper in the session chat came out with it. ([high-line !1878](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1878)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Pass the `EmailSessionReported` job the data it needs.** `processSessionEnded` queued it with the arguments in the wrong positions, so `sessionId` and `userId` arrived undefined and the job failed in `asString`. TypeScript missed it because `JSON.parse` returns `any`. The report data also stopped being written with an expiration, since it is removed from the cache once it is used and `processSessionEnded` has run more than a day late before, which would have dropped the notification. ([subway !2874](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2874)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Stop the db-test database squatting on the e2e port, so the two suites can run at once.** `database-ci` published on 5500, which `postgres-e2e` also takes. It reads `DB_PORT` now and defaults to 5502, its fixed `container_name` is gone, and `jest.config.database.js` loads `.env` before `db-test-environment.js` resolves its own default, so `DB_PORT` decides which database the suite writes to. ([subway !2877](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2877)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Move secret scanning to push time and off `detect-secrets` on high-line.** The same four changes already shipped on subway, split by commit to match: a version-controlled `.githooks` directory, Betterleaks behind the pre-commit and pre-push hooks, `secrets:check` moved onto pre-push, and a `bin/jj_pre_push` so jj users get the hooks too. ([high-line !1851](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1851)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Internal tools

- 🚀 **Show one copy of a post-session survey answer in the admin.** The "Your thoughts" text appeared twice for both students and coaches, because the questions are shared between two surveys and the query walked every survey attached to the session's subject. It joins on the survey context id too now, so only the survey the person actually answered comes back. 🐛 [#709](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/709) ([subway !2889](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2889)) *Liseidy Bueno*
